basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Junior Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has 2 posts of Junior Project Engineer - Research. The posts are in the project "Large Language Model for Legal Assistance", which is sponsored by IIT Mandi iHUB and HCi Foundation. The tenure is 12 months or the end of the project, whichever is earlier, and the consolidated pay is up to Rs. 40000 a month. Candidates need marks of 70% or more, or a 7.0 CGPA, in X, XII and BTech. Applications are invited online, and the last date is 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: IIT Kharagpur has invited applications online, and the last date of application is 10 November 2026. The notice does not name the application portal. The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.
The notice also prints a bank account for depositing the application fee by RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking:
Bank name: STATE BANK OF INDIA (00202)

content_sections.text: The Junior Project Engineer - Research post carries a consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 40000 per month. The exact amount depends on qualification and experience.
